title: using ai in bots to do your work for you
author: Cool_Big2955
selftext:
hey guys, quick question – what ai models/tools are you actually using in your trading bots right now?

i’ve been testing some stuff but honestly not sure if i’m overcomplicating it or missing something obvious. curious what’s working for others in live markets (not just backtests lol).

no need for long explanations, just wanna know what people are actually running. thanks!

comments.author: ComfortOk9514
comments.body: I tried using Claude but it gets expensive fast.

replies.author: Cool_Big2955
replies.body:
. i’ve been running qwen2.5:3b locally for my bot and it’s free after the initial download - qwen2.5:3b     357c53fb659c    1.9 GB -  no api costs at all. and add to .env    AI\_MODEL=qwen2.5:3b

if you wanna try it yourself, just install ollama in cmd/terminal and run ollama pull qwen2.5:3b. takes like 2 mins to set up. works great for trading logic without burning cash. and (qwen) chat program i use for help programming now since januar 

not saying it’s better than claude its not but he knows hes shit man , but if budget’s a concern it’s worth testing. happy to share more details if anyone’s curious!

comments.author: Routine_Bat6675
comments.body: I am using Sentimentick as stock analysis API and IBKR gateway for the execution.

comments.author: mojovski
comments.body:
I use ai to code/ build strategies and to help to design them from books I curated.

Once they are built, the run in determined mode without AI in the loop. Faster, cheaper, predictable.
Ah, and I use copy trading to synchronize the trades with metatrader.

Here is one such strategy.

Scroll down to see how the live results compare to backtest performance.

https://app.ai-backbone.com/publiclive/u_b482da68

replies.author: Emojinapp
replies.body: You replied the same thing to my own post, just giving you a taste of your own medicine. I know you probably worked hard on it so it doesn’t make sense to talk down the work of others

comments.author: TastyTrading
comments.body: ThetaPal ai market scouts are the king imo. Does all my research each night for me according to criteria I set with plain English queries. Saves hours
